newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS joins CA bid group as advisor.
newsitem.headline: UBS joins CA bid group as advisor.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said it had joined a group led by EA-Generali AG bidding for Creditanstalt (CA) as financial advisor and global coordinator for a placement of CA shares.
UBS spokesman Gertrud Erismann said the Swiss bank did not plan to take a stake in Creditanstalt if the EA-Generali consortium wins the bidding.
"We are financial advisors...If the bid is successful, we would be global coordinators for placing the part of shares that are supposed to be offered on the market," Erismann said.
UBS's Corporate Finance division was in charge of the deal, Erismann said.

Insurer EA-Generali is heading a group bidding for the Austrian government's 70 percent stake in CA and plans to place 26 percent of the government stake on the market, an EA-Generali spokesman said earlier in Vienna.
